issue_title: [Feature] 添加存储操作的日志记录功能

implementation_summary.description: Added optional logging support to TodoStorage class for load() and save() operations
acceptance_criteria_met: load() logs DEBUG with file path and record count
save() logs DEBUG with file path and record count

risks_and_limitations: Logging only occurs on successful operations, not on errors
No timing information logged (as suggested in issue) - kept minimal for initial implementation
